    GoToObject(robot, 'Curtains')

    GoToObject(robot, 'FloorLamp')
    SwitchOn(robot, 'FloorLamp')
    GoToObject(robot, 'Sofa')
    PullObject(robot, 'Sofa')

def prepare_snack(robots):
    # SubTask 2: Prepare a Snack using team of robots
    GoToObject(robots[0], 'Apple')
    PickupObject(robots[0], 'Apple')
    GoToObject(robots[0], 'Knife')
    SliceObject(robots[0], 'Apple')
    GoToObject(robots[0], 'Plate')
